purpose: Single machine-readable registry of control artifacts that every fresh worker must load before substantive work.
conflict_rule: Every wake reloads fresh ACTIVE_CONTROLS and mandatory artifacts, including state/P0_SCORECARD.json; prior-wake cached policy cannot override them. P0 scorecard timing must match the operator-locked normal CONTINUE floor of 10 minutes (600 seconds) and normal final rearm of exactly 1 minute (60 seconds). Before selecting a corrective timing experiment, read both state/SCHEDULER_OBSERVATIONS.json and state/STARTUP_BUDGET.json so local rearm arithmetic, provider delivery, and post-observation startup are not conflated. CI/workflow surfaces listed in mandatory_policy_sync_surfaces are enforcement mirrors: whenever an active policy value changes, update those mirrors in the same coherent change set or treat the mismatch as policy drift and fail closed for the disputed assertion. TIME-UNIT SAFETY: every human-readable duration/offset/timeout/threshold/guard must state an explicit unit; critical relay timings must state both human unit and exact seconds. Bare unitless timing arithmetic is forbidden. RRULE FREQ=HOURLY never changes an explicitly stated second-based offset. Normal nonterminal CONTINUE cannot voluntarily close before 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds). Current clean MAIN=6ab152b636748191a71873ba4d5ef551. For the normal 10-minute (600-second) envelope, provisional recurrence is armed once at observed wake + exactly 11 minutes (660 seconds); repeated 2-minute (120-second) rolling refresh is forbidden as the normal strategy because prior live A/B evidence showed overlap. The former 13-minute (780-second) provisional is retired. Extend SAME MAIN only if work/close handling clearly threatens the 11-minute (660-second) due. Normal close shifts only THIS SAME MAIN to ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds). This means sixty seconds after observed END, never 60 minutes and never the next natural hourly RRULE occurrence. Predictive-prearm artifacts and their no-dual-authority invariant are historical safety evidence only, not active close authority. Never reactivate retired MAIN canonicals. Watchdog remains disabled standby. V5.5 trace canary: after provisional rearm is live-verified, emit one compact schedule trace; after each actually completed bounded substantive unit whose duration/work evidence is durably persisted, emit one compact completion trace and immediately continue same-wake work while the 10-minute (600-second) floor is unmet. Progress traces are observability only and never authorize close. After ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds) live verification, emit one compact next-due trace.
